blind.description: A stylized fantasy/tribal chieftain throne built from massive animal bones and tusks bound with red cloth wrappings, featuring a prominent horned beast skull backrest and a dark fur/pelt seat. The throne rests atop and is surrounded by an assortment of loot and supplies, including wooden crates, a horizontal barrel, sacks tied with rope, a round green shield with a metallic boss, a small treasure chest, and rolled red fabric. The back shows supporting wooden framing and open storage crates. Surfaces are clean, continuous, and textured in a hand-painted game-ready style with no structural artifacts or floating pieces.
blind.from_above: Seen directly from above, it appears as a square-footprint cluster of wooden crates and bags surrounding a central dark fur seat, framed by bone armrests and the top of a horned skull backrest flanked by two dark-topped bone posts, with a green shield and barrel visible along the edges.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4.5 to 5.0 feet tall (around 80% the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and roughly 4.5 to 5 feet wide, fitting neatly within a 5-foot grid square.
